policy: Repetition, forwarding, clipping, or media mirroring is not counted as corroboration unless an independent attributable source supports the narrow claim.

groups.name: Witness II FD-302 chain
groups.limitation: The 302 records what the witness reported and is not independent verification.

groups.name: Katie Johnson pleading and denial chain
chain: Court pleading path not certified in reviewed archive set
groups.independence: pleading capture plus derivative media; certified docket missing
groups.limitation: A legal pleading records allegations made by a party; filing an allegation does not establish that the allegation is true.

groups.name: Wolff draft hearsay chain
groups.independence: draft/email hearsay; related note supports only elevator-girl context
groups.limitation: A draft manuscript and attributed hearsay are not independent verification.

groups.name: Epstein deposition socialization chain
groups.independence: independent legal transcript for narrow socialization admission
groups.limitation: Epstein's admission that he socialized with Trump does not establish misconduct; constitutional assertions are not admissions.

groups.name: Contact-directory recollection chain
groups.independence: witness recollection of a directory; original directory page missing
groups.limitation: Contact information or a recalled name in a directory is not evidence of interaction or misconduct.

groups.name: Mar-a-Lago and Giuffre context chain
groups.independence: press captures drawing on prior accounts; primary employment and ban records missing
groups.limitation: Presence at or employment by Mar-a-Lago does not prove interaction with Trump or misconduct by Trump.

groups.name: Palm Beach / Reiter investigation chain
chain: Michael Reiter memo described by press
Palm Beach Post archive capture EFTA00067339
groups.independence: local press account; primary memo not present
groups.limitation: The source supports the existence of press reporting about the memo and defense rebuttal, not a Trump-specific allegation.

groups.name: Trump Tower correspondence chain
groups.limitation: The emails mention Trump Tower or Trump Tower Istanbul but do not establish Trump-Epstein interaction.

duplicate_or_derivative_groups.name: Katie Johnson media mirrors and forwards
duplicate_or_derivative_groups.rule: Count as one allegation lane unless a certified court record or independent evidence is acquired.

duplicate_or_derivative_groups.name: Daily Mail Giuffre / Mar-a-Lago duplicate capture
duplicate_or_derivative_groups.rule: Duplicate press scans do not increase corroboration.

duplicate_or_derivative_groups.name: Wolff draft and related Westerhout note
duplicate_or_derivative_groups.rule: Related emails are not independent verification of the draft allegation.
